notes: Black Friday offer statics from 5 user-supplied refs (Nov 19). Current offer 40% off + free case & bag + free shipping + 120-day guarantee. Invented scarcity/overstock stories from the refs are replaced with honest lines.

concepts.based_on: Ref: Sonic Dental BF 'UP TO 40% OFF' + pill. Ours is a flat 40% (no 'up to').
concepts.headline: 40% OFF. Black Friday Sale.
concepts.prompt: Recreate the layout of the SECOND attached image closely: a soft light-grey studio background. Top center huge heavy black text "40% OFF" with a DentalPULSE-blue (#1188FF) rounded pill laid diagonally across the middle of the number reading in white bold caps "BLACK FRIDAY SALE". Above it, small dark caps "DENTALPULSE ULTRASONIC CLEANER". Below: the white DentalPULSE Pod from the first reference image with its lid closed, the small dental case and the travel bag beside it at their true sizes, and a yellow-stained upper denture in front. Bottom center small dark text "FREE case + travel bag + shipping". IMPORTANT: the ONLY words in the image are the quoted texts above, each rendered exactly once and spelled exactly, in a clean bold sans like the reference; no other text, no logos except the DentalPULSE wordmark where quoted and the wordmark printed on the Pod, no competitor names. POD RULES: the DentalPULSE Pod RESTS on a surface; NOBODY holds it. Compact device about 13 cm wide and 8.5 cm tall, never a big machine. The free dental case and travel bag are shown at their true size (bag about the Pod's size, case about half). Any appliance is about HALF the Pod's width. Any stained denture is UNMISTAKABLY yellow-brown; a clean one has bright white teeth and fresh pink gums.
